title: fanoutqa: Out of the top 5 Formula 1 drivers with the most race wins, who was born before 1990? (36ca6edd0420b273)

chat_history.content: Out of the top 5 Formula 1 drivers with the most race wins, who was born before 1990?

content.content: We need to list top 5 F1 drivers with most race wins, then identify which of those were born before 1990. Need up-to-date data? As of 2025? Top 5 drivers by race wins historically: Lewis Hamilton (103+), Michael Schumacher (91), Sebastian Vettel (53), Alain Prost (51), Ayrton Senna (41) maybe? Actually check: as of 2024, drivers' win counts: Hamilton 103, Schumacher 91, Vettel 53, Prost 51, Fernando Alonso 32 (but not top5). Max Verstappen now maybe surpass? He has 56 wins as of 2024, surpass Vettel? Actually Verstappen has 56 wins (as of 2024). So top5 might be Hamilton, Schumacher, Verstappen, Vettel, Prost. Need births: Hamilton 1985, Schumacher 1969, Verstappen 1997, Vettel 1983, Prost 1955. Those born before 1990: Hamilton, Schumacher, Vettel, Prost. So answer those. Provide list.

content:
**Top 5 Formula 1 drivers by career race wins (as of the end of the 2024 season)**  

| Rank | Driver | Career Wins | Year of Birth |
|------|--------|------------|---------------|
| 1 | Lewis Hamilton | 103 | **1985** |
| 2 | Michael Schumacher | 91 | **1969** |
| 3 | Max Verstappen | 56 | 1997 |
| 4 | Sebastian Vettel | 53 | **1983** |
| 5 | Alain Prost | 51 | **1955** |

### Drivers born **before 1990**

- **Lewis Hamilton** – born 8 January 1985  
- **Michael Schumacher** – born 3 January 1969  
- **Sebastian Vettel** – born 3 July 1983  
- **Alain Prost** – born 24 February 1955  

(Max Verstappen, born 30 September 1997, does **not** meet the “born before 1990” criterion.)
